notes.title: V1.3.0 Update Contents
notes.notes:
Updated to V1.3.0.



・Ten new professions have been added.

You can unlock new professions by spending coins on targeted in the 'Enhancement' section.

New professions will be added to the 'Enhancement' when a new chronicle is started.

The data in the middle of the Chronicle, prior to the update that added professions, 

will remain consistent and can be played as it is, without reflecting the new profession items in the enhancements.

Please note that this will be added either when you advance the chronicle to the end,

or when you select 'From Beginning'.



・Addition of 4 types of combined techniques

With the addition of the new professions, four types of combined techniques were added.

A new combined technique that is activated by combining an existing occupation with a new occupation has been added.



・Add historical events.

Chronicle history events were added along with the addition of professions, etc.



・Various bug fixes

notes.title: V1.2.0 Update Contents
notes.notes:
Updated to V1.2.0.



・Addition of special techniques and soul cards

Five new special techniques and three new soul cards have been added.

They will be added at the time you advance the chronicle to the ending once or select “From the Beginning” and start a new chronicle.

In addition to the above, you will need to fulfill conditions in the game to add new soul cards to the enhancements.

If you have already met the requirements in previous versions of the game, they will be added to the enhancements at 

when you start a new Chronicle.



・Adjustment to reduce enemy resistance to abnormal conditions

Adjustments were made to lower the resistance to abnormalities on 

the enemy side to make it easier to activate each abnormality.



・Correction to add abnormal conditions damage to the damage display in Results.

Damage values in the result now add the damage from the abnormal condition.



・Various bug fixes



Thank you for your continued support of “THE GENERAL SAGA”.

notes.title: “THE GENERAL SAGA” V1.2.0 Update Notice
notes.notes:
Thank you for playing THE GENERAL SAGA.Thank you also for your valuable feedback.

This announcement is a preview of V1.2.0 update.

The following additions and adjustments are planned.



・Addition of special techniques

Five new special techniques will be added.



・Addition of Soul Card

Three new soul cards will be added.



・Adjustment to reduce enemy resistance to abnormal conditions

We plan to adjust the resistance to abnormalities on the enemy side to be lowered slightly 

to make it easier to activate each abnormality.



・Correction to add condition-based damage to the damage display in Results.

We plan to modify the damage value inflicted by each character in the results to add 

the damage value from the condition.



V1.2.0 will be available soon.

notes.title: “THE GENERAL SAGA” V1.1.0 Update Notice
notes.notes:
Thank you for playing “THE GENERAL SAGA” and for your many comments and requests.
This announcement is a preview of V1.1.0 update.
V1.1.0 will be updated with the addition of new professions, as well as additional features to match the additional professions.
V1.1.0 will be available soon.
The main planned contents of the V1.1.0 update are as follows

・Ten new professions have been added
Ten new professions will be added.
You can unlock new professions by spending coins on targeted in the 'Enhancement' section.
New professions will be added to the 'Enhancement' when a new chronicle is started.
The data in the middle of the Chronicle, prior to the update that added professions, will remain consistent and can be played as it is, without reflecting the new profession items in the enhancements.
Please note that this will be added either when you advance the chronicle to the end, or when you select  'From Beginning'.

・Addition of a prohibition function
When 16 or more professions are open and available, a new function will be added that will allow each profession to be prohibited from going into battle.
Professions that have been banned will no longer be eligible for selection in the levelling-up lottery.

・The de-enhancement and coin refund features have been added.
Add the option to remove the current enhancement and refund the coins spent.

・Added help function
Add the ability to display a detailed description when a profession or equipment item is selected.

・The TIPS display function has been added during games.
Add a TIPS display function to the pause menu.

・The expected amount of coins obtained for each stage has been revised upwards.
The expected amount of coins obtained per play at each stage will be increased through adjustments.

notes.title: V1.0.2 Update Contents
notes.notes:
Updated to V1.0.2.

・Reduce the experience required to level up in the game
　Fixed the balance of slow level-up speed in 10 minutes and the tendency to always be in equilibrium 
   with the enemy. We have adjusted the balance so that steady level-up can overwhelm the enemy.

・Increased effectiveness of enhancements
　Adjustments have been made to increase the effectiveness of a number of permanent enhancements.

・Display showing the details of the profession enhancements
　The effect details of permanent enhancements by occupation have been modified so that the 
   information is known before execution.

・Added an effect to enemy enhancements to increase in-game currency when completing a stage
　Added an effect that increases the in-game currency earned when clearing a stage for each enemy 
   enhancements set.

・Balance adjustment in some stages
　Adjusted the balance of some stages to match the speed of level-up.

・Improved all combined techniques
　Adjustments have been made to improve the basic performance of the combined technique.

・Change the color of enemy bullets
　Changed the color of enemy bullets to improve visibility

・Corrected reroll draw
　Fixed to not include items at the time of reroll in the lottery when reroll is used


We continue to plan to update to V1.0.3 or later.
Thank you for your continued support of “THE GENERAL SAGA”.

notes.title: “THE GENERAL SAGA” V1.0.2 Update Notice
notes.notes:
Thank you for playing “THE GENERAL SAGA” and for your many comments and requests.
This announcement is a preview of V1.0.2 update.
In V1.0.2, we will mainly be reworking the game balance and making various changes to make the game easier to play.
V1.0.2 will be available soon.
The following are the planned changes in the V1.0.2 update.

・Reduce the experience required to level up in the game
・Increased effectiveness of enhancements
・Display showing the details of the profession enhancements
・Added an effect to enemy enhancements to increase in-game currency when completing a stage
・Balance adjustment in some stages
・Improved all combined techniques

Updates will continue to be scheduled for V1.0.2 and beyond.
We will take your feedback seriously and strive to make the game easier to play and more enjoyable for more people.
We look forward to your continued support of “THE GENERAL SAGA”.

notes.title: V1.0.1 Update Contents
notes.notes:
Updated to V1.0.1.

・Added “Fixed Shot Mode” for general operation.
　Fixed Shot Mode is now the default operation and can be switched at any time to Direction-of-movement Shot Mode.
・Added ON/OFF display for Fixed Shot Mode.
・Added PAUSE button display.
・Formation rotation operation button guide display is now displayed for a certain period of time after start.
・Removed the influence of the equipment item “Feather” on the formation rotation speed. Adjusted the formation rotation speed to be faster from the beginning.
・Adjustment to increase the number of item targets at level up.
・Other minor bug fixes.

We continue to plan to update to V1.0.2 or later.
Thank you for your continued support of “THE GENERAL SAGA”.
